text:
Silver Price in 2021
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2021, the LBMA silver price fell 15.8% between 2021-01-29 ($27.42) and 2021-12-31 ($23.09). The highest sampled price was $27.63 in May and the lowest was $21.53 in September. The mean of these observations was $24.87. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
